blocks.html:
Open-type expansion tanks shall be located not less than 4 feet (1219.2 mm) above the highest heating element. The tank shall be adequately sized for the hot water system. An overflow with a minimum diameter of 1 inch (25.4 mm) shall be installed at the top of the tank. The overflow shall discharge to the drainage system in accordance with the New York City Plumbing Code.
Section MC 1010: Gauges
